plainTranslation: Person B (Mercury)'s way of explaining and considering an idea can contrast with Person A (Mars)'s impulse to challenge it or put an intention into action. A discussion may feel stimulating to one person and adversarial to the other. Person A (Mars) can press a point strongly; Person B (Mercury) may respond with more argument or verbal precision, further increasing the pressure between them. The opposition can make each person's position more apparent without making agreement automatic. The disagreement concerns the interaction between thinking, expression and assertion, rather than a fixed division into a thoughtful person and an aggressive person. Natal condition and other contacts are needed to establish a stronger judgment about the relationship.

summaryDeep: Their initiative, urgency, directness, and temper press against your thinking and how you talk and decide. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
tension: The challenge is becoming attached to being right. When disagreement turns into defensiveness, the conversation stops teaching you anything.
advice: The gift of this connection is learning through contrast. What this person questions may be exactly what helps you understand yourself more clearly.
